text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Sev 2 — Halcyon Financial (tenant: halcyon / vpc-hcy) reporting elevated 5xx rate on dedicated pool. Customer-visible failures on checkout flow. Affected model: gptx-open-13b-v1 (dedicated variant). Suggested mitigations: tenant-safe-variant switch OR route to hosted fallback. Link to runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/tenant-fallback

maya: oncall here, taking. paging @victor @jess for SRE/eng assistance. Priya, can you confirm customer impact details? :phone:

priya: Halcyon on the bridge — "users see checkout failures, about 20% of requests failing in last 5m". They're able to reproduce with production prompt. Want ETA and mitigation steps.

victor: joining. Quick look at metrics: p95 latency spikes + sustained 503s from serving tier. KV cache growth and OOM traces on some GPUs around 23:04. Correlates with long-concat customer sessions (very long context). Suspect memory pressure on the 13b variant.

jess: TLDR: we should avoid a full model swap if we can. Two options: 1) route halcyon -> safevariant gptx-open-8b-quant (lower mem) OR 2) route to hosted fallback (gptx-hosted-13b-stable) if customer allows external routing. Recommend safevariant immediate then canary back.

maya: executing immediate safevariant switch (authorized by SRE). Command I will run:```bash
# switch tenant fallback to low-memory safe variant (immediate)
redwood routing set --tenant halcyon --fallback-model gptx-open-8b-quant --priority emergency --mode immediate
```

ops-bot: job started: routing-change-5151234567, job-id=job-7f3d2b. Rolling change to dedicated routing table.

victor: change applied. Observing metrics now — within 90s p95 dropped from ~1.2s to ~260ms, 5xx rates falling. KV cache pressure reduced. Confirming Halcyon test requests are succeeding.

jess: good. Plan: keep safevariant for 30m, then start a rolling canary to baseline model: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 30m windows if stable. I'll prepare canary config and a short rollback (route all back to safevariant). Also add a transient prompt-length guard for this tenant to cap max tokens and prevent long KV growth.

priya: Halcyon on bridge: "checkout is green now, thank you." They requested post-incident timeline and an RCA once available. I'm collecting customer logs and will attach to the postmortem.

maya: handing to eng oncall for RCA and follow-up. @jess please own RCA and include: why KV growth hit capacity, whether we need automatic tenant-level max-context guards, and whether model variant selection heuristics should consider session length. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: routing-change-5151234567 completed successfully. job-id=job-7f3d2b, duration=2m3s.

victor: I'll keep a 15m watch and then sleep on-call transfer to oncall-next. If regressions occur we rollback with:```bash
redwood routing set --tenant halcyon --force-fallback gptx-open-8b-quant --mode immediate
```

jess: noted. I'll open a follow-up PR for: tenant-context-guards + telemetry to surface per-tenant token distributions. ETA for PR: EOD.

maya: closing channel for active mitigation; will remain on bridge until handoff at +30m. Great work team. :thumbsup:
